notes.title: Controller and Localization Update!
notes.content:
The next Major Update is here which features Localization and Controller Improvements.


The Game can now be mostly translated to 8 different languages including English, Japanese, Chinese (simplified), Korean, French, Italian, German, & Russian!

Look for the language drop down menu in the upper right corner when you enter the game!


Other Improved include:

a Controller change that allows detection of Controllers and Assignment of buttons and Layout to each player. 

general bug fixes includes some animation glitches. 


thank you for your time.

notes.title: Major Graphics Update
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has supported my Game thus far and thank you to future supporters. i am pleased to announce a Major Graphics Update  for Raging Fists: Retribution!

[b][u]new features and bug fixes:[/u][/b]

[list]
[*]Major Lightning improvements
[*]Sharper Image Quality
[*] Vivid Visuals and Shadows
[*] Fixed a few misplaced Textures
[*] Upgraded to HDRP in Unity3D(High Definition Rendering)
[/list]

Please to provide me with feedback if you experience any issues, via my Company website: Supertechdude.com


Thanks,

Mario Santorelli
Owner of
SuperTechDude
